# baffinbay_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay Certificate by UUID or exact common name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_certificate" "proxy" {
  common_name = "proxy.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `common_name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive certificate common name. Exactly one of `id` or `common_name` must be configured.
- `id` (String) The certificate UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `common_name` must be configured.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String)
- `type` (String) The API certificate type.
